types.name: decision
types.description: A design/architecture/scope choice that was made (often by George), including choosing NOT to adopt or continue something, with its rationale.

roles.name: subject
roles.description: the system, component, project or problem the decision is about

roles.name: choice
roles.description: short phrase of what was chosen (or 'not adopted' / 'removed')

roles.name: alternative
roles.description: the option rejected or not chosen, if named

roles.name: decided_by
roles.description: person who made the call (e.g. George)

roles.name: rationale
roles.description: short quoted reason for the choice

roles.name: date
roles.description: date the decision was made

types.name: trap
types.description: A gotcha: a tool/system misbehaves in a non-obvious way (symptom + cause) and there is a known workaround or avoidance.

roles.name: tool
roles.description: the tool, library, CLI or system that misbehaves

roles.name: symptom
roles.description: the observable failure or error message

roles.name: cause
roles.description: root cause phrase, if stated

roles.name: workaround
roles.description: what to do instead / the fix

roles.name: environment
roles.description: host, repo or setup where the trap applies, if scoped

types.name: system_behavior
types.description: A non-obvious but stable property or rule of how a system works (no failure implied), e.g. CI semantics, write paths, triggers, caching.

roles.name: system
roles.description: the system, service, table or workflow described

roles.name: behavior
roles.description: short phrase describing what it does

roles.name: condition
roles.description: the situation in which the behavior applies

roles.name: version
roles.description: version or date the behavior was observed at, if stated

types.name: compatibility
types.description: A version/environment requirement or incompatibility between a tool and its environment (pinned version, minimum runtime, driver too old).

roles.name: tool
roles.description: the tool, package or library

roles.name: environment
roles.description: host, runtime, kernel, driver or repo it must run in

roles.name: required_version
roles.description: the version that is required or pinned

roles.name: installed_version
roles.description: the incompatible version actually present

roles.name: path
roles.description: path to a working binary/interpreter, if given

types.name: incident
types.description: Something broke or went down at a point in time (main broken, service OOM, host reboot, queue wedged), with cause and impact.

roles.name: system
roles.description: the service, branch, host or pipeline affected

roles.name: symptom
roles.description: what was observed going wrong

roles.name: cause
roles.description: root cause, if known

roles.name: date
roles.description: when it happened

roles.name: remediation
roles.description: what was done or must be done to recover

roles.name: tracking_id
roles.description: incident id, PR or ticket number

types.name: dispatch
types.description: A background job/agent session was launched (tmux session, Modal app, scheduled run) with a worktree, branch and goal.

roles.name: session
roles.description: tmux session / job / app name

roles.name: worktree
roles.description: worktree or working directory it runs in

roles.name: branch
roles.description: git branch the job works on

roles.name: goal
roles.description: short phrase of what it will deliver

roles.name: started_at
roles.description: launch timestamp

types.name: pr_state
types.description: The state of a specific pull request: number, branch, base and status (draft, ready to integrate, merged, blocked, CI failing).

roles.name: pr_number
roles.description: PR number, e.g. #18596

roles.name: branch
roles.description: head branch of the PR

roles.name: base
roles.description: base branch the PR targets

roles.name: status
roles.description: draft / ready to integrate / merged / CI fixed / blocked etc.

roles.name: feature
roles.description: the feature or component the PR delivers

roles.name: date
roles.description: date the status was observed

types.name: work_status
types.description: Progress status of a workstream or project (active, complete, blocked, paused), and what blocks it, independent of a single PR.

roles.name: workstream
roles.description: the project, experiment or workstream

roles.name: status
roles.description: active / complete / blocked / paused / abandoned

roles.name: blocker
roles.description: what it is blocked on, if blocked

roles.name: tracking_id
roles.description: Linear issue, PR or project id

roles.name: date
roles.description: date the status was recorded

types.name: measurement
types.description: A measured result: a metric value for a subject (model, method, config) on a dataset/condition, from an eval, benchmark or scan.

roles.name: subject
roles.description: the model, method, pipeline or config measured

roles.name: metric
roles.description: metric name, e.g. F1, AUROC, max-abs error, AP

roles.name: value
roles.description: the measured number

roles.name: dataset
roles.description: dataset, camera or site measured on

roles.name: condition
roles.description: setting/comparison qualifier (precision, baseline, split)

types.name: limit_setting
types.description: A configured parameter, threshold, cap or limit of a system (size limits, timeouts, URL expiry, step caps, calibrated thresholds).

roles.name: system
roles.description: the system or component the parameter belongs to

roles.name: parameter
roles.description: parameter or limit name

roles.name: value
roles.description: its value with unit

roles.name: scope
roles.description: site, camera, model or environment the value is scoped to

types.name: price
types.description: The cost of using a model, API, compute or service (per token, per image, per edit, per frame).

roles.name: item
roles.description: model, API or service being priced

roles.name: provider
roles.description: vendor or host

roles.name: amount
roles.description: price figure with currency

roles.name: unit
roles.description: billing unit, e.g. per M tokens, per edit, per 1k frames

types.name: budget
types.description: A spending allowance or cap authorised for a task, workstream, site or period.

roles.name: scope
roles.description: task, workstream, customer or site the budget covers

roles.name: amount
roles.description: budget amount with currency

roles.name: period
roles.description: per task / per month etc.

roles.name: authorised_by
roles.description: person who set it

roles.name: covers
roles.description: what spend is included (inference, training, ...)

types.name: model_capability
types.description: Whether a specific model on a specific provider/endpoint supports a capability (images, thinking flag, region, API), or its specs.

roles.name: model
roles.description: the model id

roles.name: provider
roles.description: provider / endpoint / region serving it

roles.name: capability
roles.description: capability or feature in question (vision input, image gen, context length)

roles.name: supported
roles.description: yes / no / condition under which it works

roles.name: date
roles.description: date verified

types.name: service_availability
types.description: Whether a service, account or integration is currently usable (no credits, no access, killed API, live and verified).

roles.name: service
roles.description: the service, API, account or integration

roles.name: status
roles.description: available / unavailable / degraded / deprecated

roles.name: cause
roles.description: why, e.g. quota exhausted, missing permission

roles.name: date
roles.description: date observed

types.name: credential_access
types.description: Which credential/secret/identity can or cannot access which resource, and where that secret is stored.

roles.name: credential
roles.description: secret, key, service account or DB role

roles.name: resource
roles.description: database, bucket, API or system accessed

roles.name: access
roles.description: works / fails / permission granted or lacking

roles.name: secret_location
roles.description: path of the secrets file or secret-manager name

roles.name: date
roles.description: date verified

types.name: storage_location
types.description: Where a kind of data or artefact lives (table, bucket path, directory, package) - 'X lives in Y'.

roles.name: subject
roles.description: the data, artefact, code or config being located

roles.name: location
roles.description: table name, gs:// path, file path or package

roles.name: system
roles.description: the database/store/repo containing it

roles.name: note
roles.description: short qualifier, e.g. 'write both', 'not the json file'

types.name: reference_pointer
types.description: A pointer to an external resource (doc, URL, Slack channel, Linear doc, artefact, research digest) and what it is for or found.

roles.name: resource
roles.description: the document, channel, artefact, paper set or tool referenced

roles.name: location
roles.description: URL, channel id, doc id or path

roles.name: purpose
roles.description: what it is for or the key finding it holds

roles.name: date
roles.description: date created or consulted

types.name: procedure
types.description: How to accomplish a specific task: the command(s) or ordered steps, often for an operation that otherwise fails.

roles.name: task
roles.description: the task being done, as a short phrase

roles.name: tool
roles.description: main tool/system used

roles.name: command
roles.description: the command or step sequence

roles.name: precondition
roles.description: what must be true / set up first

types.name: preference
types.description: A person's stated preference for one tool/approach over another, or a ban on a tool/vendor, in some context.

roles.name: person
roles.description: who holds the preference (usually George)

roles.name: preferred
roles.description: tool, library or approach preferred

roles.name: avoided
roles.description: tool or approach disfavoured or banned

roles.name: context
roles.description: domain where the preference applies

roles.name: reason
roles.description: why, if stated

types.name: working_rule
types.description: A standing always/never rule for how the agent must work or what deliverables must include (process, reporting, style), not tied to one tool choice.

roles.name: context
roles.description: the activity the rule governs (training, reporting, git, analysis HTML)

roles.name: directive
roles.description: the always/never instruction

roles.name: issued_by
roles.description: who set the rule

roles.name: reason
roles.description: the incident or rationale behind it

types.name: ownership
types.description: Who/what is responsible for or exclusively allowed to act on a resource (integrator merges, service owns a port, team owns a system).

roles.name: owner
roles.description: person, session, service or team responsible

roles.name: resource
roles.description: worktree, branch, port, system or process owned

roles.name: responsibility
roles.description: what the owner does / is allowed to do

types.name: deployment_state
types.description: What is currently running live where: service, host/port, branch/commit/version and environment.

roles.name: service
roles.description: the deployed service or app

roles.name: host
roles.description: host, worktree or environment it runs on

roles.name: port
roles.description: port number(s)

roles.name: version
roles.description: branch, commit sha or release running

roles.name: date
roles.description: when observed

types.name: definition
types.description: What a term, name or codename means (George's vocabulary, method names, product aliases).

roles.name: term
roles.description: the word, name or alias

roles.name: meaning
roles.description: short definition phrase

roles.name: referent
roles.description: the system, model or method the term denotes

roles.name: defined_by
roles.description: who coined/uses it

types.name: correction
types.description: An earlier record, report, name or belief was wrong and is replaced (renames, mistaken wording, superseded facts).

roles.name: subject
roles.description: the thing whose value was corrected

roles.name: wrong_value
roles.description: the old/incorrect value or name

roles.name: correct_value
roles.description: the corrected value or name

roles.name: corrected_by
roles.description: who made the correction

roles.name: date
roles.description: when corrected

types.name: relation
types.description: A structural relation between two named things: part_of, depends_on, stacked_on, registered_in, belongs_to category, same_as.

roles.name: subject
roles.description: the first entity

roles.name: relation
roles.description: relation name, e.g. part_of, stacked_on, is_modality

roles.name: object
roles.description: the second entity

roles.name: qualifier
roles.description: ids, ranges or conditions qualifying the relation

types.name: data_issue
types.description: A defect in a dataset or data store (bad labels, misaligned GT, rewritten frames, double-normalisation, sequence drift) with its extent and remediation.

roles.name: dataset
roles.description: dataset, table, camera or image set affected

roles.name: issue
roles.description: short description of the defect

roles.name: extent
roles.description: how much is affected (count, fraction, ids)

roles.name: remediation
roles.description: fix applied or recommended

types.name: other
types.description: Catch-all for records that fit none of the other types (index/archive headers, unstructured notes).

roles.name: subject
roles.description: main entity the record is about
